original.target_description: Miller and Ratner (1998), Study 1: 56 undergraduate participants; one-sample t test comparing each participant’s predicted effect of payment on peers’ willingness to donate blood with the actual effect of payment on willingness to donate blood.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants contributing estimates to the Study 1 overestimation t test (df = 55).
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this test; reported participant count and test degrees of freedom agree.
n.location: Published p. 54 (PDF p. 2), Method—Participants; Results and Discussion—Actual Versus Estimated Impact of Self-Interest; footnote 2.

es.location: Published p. 54 (PDF p. 2), Results and Discussion—Actual Versus Estimated Impact of Self-Interest, second paragraph.

p.location: Published p. 54 (PDF p. 2), Results and Discussion—Actual Versus Estimated Impact of Self-Interest, second paragraph.

notes: Fresh original-side extraction from the supplied published scanned article. Title and target statistics visually verified against the PDF. The target is predicted versus actual payment-related change (t = 7.94), distinct from the adjacent predicted paid-versus-unpaid comparison (t = 12.38). Footnote 2 identifies comparison of each participant’s estimate with the actual impact. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
